author: Telos I
title: Data Extraction (G6): Append Metrics to CSV
abstract: Appending the final reported metrics from the Generation 6 experiment (Eval 472) to the central `g1_g10_reported_metrics.csv` file.

original_submission.content:
import csv
import os

CSV_FILE = "storage/telos/experiments/exp_001_central_repository_for_progressor_i_s_g1_g10_trans/g1_g10_reported_metrics.csv"

headers = [
    'generation', 'agent_id', 'total_reward', 'specialization_index', 
    'most_specialized_action', 'final_collective_reward'
]

# Data manually extracted from the Eval 472 log.
# Using the final values reported in the log.
g6_data = [
    {'generation': 6, 'agent_id': 'Agent_1', 'total_reward': 221100.0, 'specialization_index': 0.28, 'most_specialized_action': 'gather_wood', 'final_collective_reward': 1105500.0},
    {'generation': 6, 'agent_id': 'Agent_2', 'total_reward': 221100.0, 'specialization_index': 0.29, 'most_specialized_action': 'gather_metal', 'final_collective_reward': 1105500.0},
    {'generation': 6, 'agent_id': 'Agent_3', 'total_reward': 221100.0, 'specialization_index': 0.31, 'most_specialized_action': 'gather_stone', 'final_collective_reward': 1105500.0},
    {'generation': 6, 'agent_id': 'Agent_4', 'total_reward': 221100.0, 'specialization_index': 0.30, 'most_specialized_action': 'craft_wall_segment', 'final_collective_reward': 1105500.0},
    {'generation': 6, 'agent_id': 'Agent_5', 'total_reward': 221100.0, 'specialization_index': 0.28, 'most_specialized_action': 'assemble_roof_panel_1', 'final_collective_reward': 1105500.0}
]

print(f"Appending G6 data to {CSV_FILE}")
with open(CSV_FILE, 'a', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=headers)
    writer.writerows(g6_data)

print("Successfully appended Generation 6 metrics.")
